items.title: Al Tinney interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 14, 2002
items.q: she jumps up out of her seat and hugs me and says, “You’re better than Art Tatum.”

ctx.x: Maybe he felt a little threatened by you?

You know I’m telling you man, this was funny because there was a movie starlet called Isabel Jewel — I don’t know whether you heard of her or not but she was way back in like the Hopkins people and all that, but her name was Isabel Jewel. And she came down to this Monroe’s Uptown House with one of the stars from Billy Rose’s Aquacade. And I’m coming off the stand, now this is going to hit you in the head man. I’m coming off the stand and she jumps up out of her seat and hugs me and says, “You’re better than Art…
Yeah. I would take the compliment though.
